svg.title: Bisa — the menu bar mark
svg.desc: The split B and its rail from logo/logo.svg, alone and in one ink: the squircle, the glass and the colours stay with the app icon. The shell tints this at run time to the menu bar's ink and paints a status dot on it (desktop/src-tauri/src/tray/glyph.rs). Rasterised by `just tray-icon`.
